free_text: The patient is a 67-year-old male with a PSA of 7.5 ng/mL and a Gleason grade of 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). MRI shows a focal lesion in the peripheral zone with restricted diffusion. The patient has moderate LUTS (IPSS 9/35). Management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of treatment against patient preferences and the indolent nature of the low-grade disease.
